title: Battle map definition
description: A .bmd file (FASTBIN0): a battle map or a prefab placed in one. Each section is a list of one kind of object.

serialise_version.description: File format version: RPFM reads 23 to 27.

battlefield_building_list.description: Buildings on the map (walls, houses, towers) that units can interact with.

battlefield_building_list_far.description: Buildings drawn only from far away.

ef_line_list.description: Lines used by the battle logic (e.g. wall lines).

go_outlines.description: Outlines of areas units can go.

non_terrain_outlines.description: Outlines of areas that are not terrain.

prefab_instance_list.description: Other prefabs (BMDs) placed in this one, with their transforms.

camera_zones.description: Areas the camera is limited to.

prop_list.description: Props (models) placed on the map: keys are model paths, props refer to them by key_index.

ai_hints.description: Hints for the battle AI (defensive lines, paths).

terrain_stencil_triangle_list.description: Triangles cut out of the terrain.

playable_area.description: The playable area of the map.

composite_scene_list.description: Composite scenes (effects made of several parts).

toggleable_buildings_slot_list.description: Building slots that can be switched on or off (settlement buildings).

tree_list_reference_list.description: Tree lists used by the map.

grass_list_reference_list.description: Grass lists used by the map.
